      • findVar

        public static Var findVar(java.lang.String id,
                          SrcLoc loc)
        Find a variable. Local scope is searched first using the scope stack. Each scope contained immediately within a module, procedure or function is marked so that the local scope search stops with that block. Each scope contains a variable map. If not found in local scope, global scope is searched (the last entry in the scope stack).
        Parameters:
        id - is the variable identifier
        loc - is the source file location
        Returns:
        the variable

      • findVar

        public static Var findVar(Ident id,
                          SrcLoc loc)
        Find a variable. Local scope is searched first using the scope stack. Each scope contained immediately within a module, procedure or function is marked so that the local scope search stops with that block. Each scope contains a variable map. If not found in local scope, global scope is searched (the last entry in the scope stack).
        Parameters:

        loc - is the source file location
        Returns:

      • findVar

        public static Var findVar(java.lang.String id,
                          Context context,
                          SrcLoc loc)
        Find a variable. Local scope is searched first using the scope stack. Each scope contained immediately within a module, procedure or function is marked so that the local scope search stops with that block. Each scope contains a variable map. If not found in local scope, global scope is searched.
        Parameters:
        id - is the variable identifier
        context - is the scope context if the search is to be limited to Context.GLOBAL, Context.FILE, Context.LOCAL or Context.CALLING
        loc - is the source file location
        Returns:
        the variable

      • addVar

        public static void addVar(Var var,
                          Context context,
                          SrcLoc loc)
        Add a variable to the current scope. If one of the same name is found, an error message is printed, followed by immediate exit.
        Parameters:
        var - is the variable
        context - is the scope to which the variable is to be added, Context.GLOBAL, Context.LOCAL for the current module, procedure or function, or Context.DEFAULT for the current code block
        loc - is the source file location

      • listVars

        public static java.util.LinkedList<java.lang.Object> listVars(Context context,
                                                              boolean allsegs,
                                                              SrcLoc loc)
        List variables in one or more scopes. Local scope is searched first using the scope stack. Each scope contained immediately within a module, procedure or function is marked so that the local scope search stops with that block. Each scope contains a variable map.
        Parameters:
        context - is the scope context if the list is to be limited to Context.GLOBAL, Context.FILE, Context.LOCAL or Context.CALLING
        allsegs - is true if the variables of all file scopes are to be listed
        loc - is the source file location
        Returns:
